description: This file contains platform-specific functions and variables for upgrading firmware on various hardware devices within a Linux-based embedded system, including checks and upgrade procedures tailored to different board types.

methods.name: platform_check_image
methods.description: Checks the image suitability based on the board name and stores mount information for specific boards.

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade
methods.description: Performs firmware upgrade procedures specific to different hardware models based on the board name.
